new_questions.title: Warehouse routes
checkpoints: Repair endpoint-preserving rendering.
Implement shortest legal routing, including unreachable output.
Support badge inventory and forbidden directed edges; defend revisit behavior.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: A position is not the complete state when permissions change during traversal. Separate display output from topology and search state.

new_questions.title: Courier payments
checkpoints: Correct second-level payout precision.
Implement totals and cutoff payments without duplicate effects.
Compute peak distinct-driver activity with touching intervals.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: Money rounding is a record-level policy; payment idempotency and the identity of an active driver are separate invariants.

new_questions.title: Worker dispatch
checkpoints: Correct exact completion-boundary eligibility.
Implement idle-worker and in-flight scheduling with queued jobs.
Show deterministic ties and explain complexity using a slow small-input oracle.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: Readiness ordering and selection ordering are different: earliest completion chooses when to dispatch, lowest idle id chooses where.

new_questions.title: Bounded cache
checkpoints: Repair read promotion and eviction.
Implement resize, replacement and zero capacity.
Make get_or_put atomic and preserve state when the factory fails.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: Recency is an invariant, not insertion order. Atomic creation concerns the entire read/compute/write sequence, including cached None.

new_questions.title: Service impact
checkpoints: Fix normalized path boundaries and root behavior.
Implement direct file and deleted-directory impact.
Propagate through dependents with cycle termination.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: String prefix is not path ancestry; dependency propagation follows the reverse of the depends-on relation.

new_questions.title: Unique word selection
checkpoints: Repair legality independently from optimality.
Implement exact compatible-subset search with explicit ties.
Compare small-input brute-force results and discuss larger-input pruning.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: A validator measures legality, not whether a strategy found the best answer. Character masks compress compatibility, not the exponential worst-case search space.

new_questions.title: Expression analysis
checkpoints: Repair multi-digit metadata loading.
Analyze arithmetic cost and alias-aware temporary liveness.
Eliminate dead assignments and propagate/fold constants without changing semantics.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: First verify the fixture oracle. Cost reduction is meaningful only if dependency and liveness semantics are explicit and preserved.

new_questions.title: Room reservations
checkpoints: Repair overlap semantics.
Find earliest gaps across nested and unsorted bookings.
Keep bookings sorted and reserve atomically for concurrent callers.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: A correct overlap helper is not enough: finding and committing a reservation must share one atomic boundary.

new_questions.title: Card triples
checkpoints: Repair identity and multiplicity validation.
Implement a deterministic legal chooser and safe removal.
Compare with the exhaustive oracle; explain a changed scoring objective without silently changing legality.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: Physical-card membership is a multiset/identity constraint. Prove legality before evaluating any strategy objective.

new_questions.title: Structured logger
checkpoints: Repair inclusive severity filtering.
Implement sink isolation and explicit failure observations.
Support atomic reconfiguration and copied structured records.
new_questions.underlying_invariant: Logging success has a delivery policy. Independent sink failures and copied event snapshots keep observability from changing application state.
